# Redactify (https://redactify.daeq.in)
> Privacy-First AI Document & Resume Redaction Tool

## Core Capabilities
- 100% Client-Side Processing: Zero server uploads, zero API telemetry.
- AI-Powered PII Detection: Local BERT Named Entity Recognition for Names, Organizations, Locations.
- Multi-Format Support: PDF, DOCX (Microsoft Word), TXT.
- Format Preservation: Retains document tables, fonts, headings, and visual layout.
- Copyable PDF Layer: Exported PDFs maintain a copyable, non-PII text layer.
- Global PII Support: US SSN, UK NINO, EU IBAN, Canadian SIN, Australian TFN, Indian Aadhaar/PAN/UPI, and International Phone Numbers.

## Target Audience
- Job Seekers anonymizing resumes before recruiter submission.
- Legal & Compliance teams redacting confidential contracts under GDPR / CCPA.
- Healthcare & Enterprise staff anonymizing internal documents.
